title: Doppler secret custody
principles: Trace each value to a real consumer before Doppler admission.
Use fixed root wrappers and credential-neutral internal commands.
Give each hosted config one read-only, config-scoped, expiring token.
Keep local, CI, Preview, Production, provider and public claims separate.
Remove only exact legacy GitHub copies after merged-path proof; never revoke an underlying credential still consumed through Doppler.

tasks.title: Prove the consumer inventory and Doppler layout
tasks.description: Trace current source, workflow, Vercel, Alchemy, GitHub and secret-custody metadata, then admit only dev, stg and prd.
implementationNotes: Verified the exact repository, Personal Doppler workplace, GitHub Environments, Personal Vercel team/projects, current missing Git links, R2 state owner and current workflow consumers without reading secret values.
Confirmed Personal Developer plan does not expose service accounts or OIDC identities, so the fallback is expiring config-scoped service tokens.
mandatoryVerification: Every inventory row names source owner, consumer, environment, classification, desired config and migration state.
No Vercel runtime value or Alchemy deployment ownership is moved into Doppler.
The synthetic Executor endpoint and key are classified as non-secret local verification inputs.
completionCriteria: Only real consumers support dev, stg and prd.
Naming and least-privilege decisions are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement bounded repository and provider custody
tasks.description: Add root/internal command splits, pinned output-only workflow fetches, executable contract tests, Doppler metadata, and exact GitHub Environment tokens without deleting legacy values.
implementationNotes: Created Personal Doppler root configs dev, stg and prd; loaded only the inventoried key sets and left the automatic empty dev_personal branch config without dummy values.
Stored one 30-day read-only config token in each exact GitHub Environment. The 15-minute stg migration token is no longer stored in GitHub and will expire without manual revocation.
Final-source Preview run 32676125884 proved fetch, custody materialisation, manifest digest and sanitised receipt; native Alchemy provider readback remained inconclusive.
mandatoryVerification: Workflow tests reject a changed action pin, direct legacy secret reference, missing named output, broad injection, root wrapper use in GitHub and fork credential exposure.
Knip accepts the external Doppler binary and no other lint or boundary rule is weakened.
Doppler readback reports only project/config/key names and token scope/expiry metadata; GitHub readback reports only secret names.
Existing Effect Schemas, redacted Config values, exact project routing, provider Layers, replay and receipt contracts remain unchanged.
completionCriteria: Repository checks pass on the exact source.
Doppler and GitHub metadata match the approved three-config layout.
No legacy provider secret or variable is deleted or revoked.

tasks.title: Open the PR and separate hosted proof from non-claims
tasks.description: Push the focused branch, open a PR to main, wait for checks, fix change-caused failures and record exact remaining cleanup.
implementationNotes: Opened PR #7 against main and retained the no-merge, no-deploy and no-cleanup boundaries.
Hosted CI run 32676441398 passed on exact head bb74bd25867f1a840a1c359cde9187270611c416.
Preview run 32676441344 proved Doppler fetch/custody and then failed closed on the recorded inconclusive native Alchemy readback; this is not a Production or public-behaviour claim.
mandatoryVerification: Hosted CI is bound to the exact PR head SHA.
Same-repository Preview drift proves only the stg fetch and report path when it runs successfully.
No Production workflow, deployment, promotion, public journey, secret deletion or token revocation is triggered.
A fresh ownership/call-graph, implementation-quality and verification-coverage review finds no unresolved change-caused defect.
completionCriteria: The PR URL and final check state are recorded.
Remaining post-merge proof and cleanup need explicit approval and exact target readback.

tasks.title: Re-admit exact Preview metadata, merge, prove Production and clean legacy GitHub copies
tasks.description: Use Cooper's 2026-08-24 continuation approval to combine PR #6's provider corrections with PR #7, refresh only the changed accepted Preview metadata from repeated read-only evidence, require exact-head checks, merge, observe the automatic Production result, then delete only the nine proved-unused legacy GitHub copies.
implementationNotes: PR #6's exact-project Vercel, R2, Marketplace and drift-classification corrections are being integrated into PR #7 while the Doppler workflow hand-off remains authoritative.
Eight live Preview Vercel environment rows, four per project, were mapped from the fail-closed receipt. Their metadata changed after the accepted manifest; their values remain unclaimed.

The personal 1Password CLI session timed out twice, so no Tilt account or alternate credential source was used. The continuation instead narrows inventory to the already-proved exact-project credentials held in bundjil/stg.
mandatoryVerification: Two consecutive exact-project read-only inventories encode the same canonical provider manifest with providerWrites zero.
The refreshed accepted manifest is Schema-encoded, digest-bound, compressed in memory and installed in bundjil/stg without logging a value.
Exact-head CI and Preview drift pass before merge; the automatic Production run is tied to the merged main SHA.
GitHub cleanup deletes only the five legacy secret names and four legacy variable names in the exact two Environments, then name-only readback proves DOPPLER_TOKEN remains.
No underlying Vercel credential is revoked, no permission is widened and no public behaviour is claimed without a direct journey.
completionCriteria: PR #7 is merged after exact-head green checks.
Automatic Production and provider readbacks are recorded separately.
The exact legacy GitHub copies are absent and Doppler metadata remains current.
All local and hosted checks required by the repository pass on their recorded source identities.
